name: google-calendar
description: Manage Google Calendar events and schedules

ai.insodimension.dimension.title: Google Calendar
examples: Check my availability this Thursday afternoon and suggest the best two meeting slots
Summarize my calendar for tomorrow and flag anything that overlaps
Create a 30-minute customer sync at 2 PM Pacific this Friday

setup.title: Reuse (or create) your Google Cloud OAuth client
setup.detail: If you set up Google Drive you already have one — the same Desktop-app OAuth client works here. If not, create a free Google Cloud project and a Desktop-app OAuth client (no billing, no redirect URI to register).

setup.title: Enable the Google Calendar API
setup.detail: APIs & Services → Library → "Google Calendar API" → Enable. Creating the client is NOT enough — without this step the connection succeeds but every Calendar call fails.

setup.title: Copy the Client ID and Client Secret into the form below
setup.detail: Same values as your Drive connector — they stay on this machine.

form.label: OAuth Client ID
form.help: Reuse the SAME OAuth client you created for Google Drive — no new Cloud project needed; just also enable the Google Calendar API. If you don't have one yet, follow the steps above.

form.label: OAuth Client Secret
form.help: The same Client Secret as your Drive connector. Google issues one for Desktop app clients even though it isn't treated as secret for installed apps (RFC 8252). Copy it from the same credential page.

failures.match: has not been used in project|is disabled|SERVICE_DISABLED|accessNotConfigured
failures.title: Enable the Google Calendar API
failures.detail: Your account connected, but the Google Cloud project has the Calendar API turned off. Enable it, wait a minute, then connect again.

failures.title: Reconnect your Google account
failures.detail: The stored token is no longer valid — run Connect again to re-authorize.

tools.name: google_calendar_list_calendars
tools.description: List the calendars in the connected Google account — id, name, primary flag, and time zone.

tools.name: google_calendar_list_events
tools.description: List or search events on a calendar within a bounded [timeMin, timeMax) window. Returns start–end, summary, id, location, and attendee count.

tools.name: google_calendar_get_event
tools.description: Read one event's full detail — attendees with RSVP status, description, recurrence, conferencing link, and reminders.

tools.name: google_calendar_find_free_slots
tools.description: Query busy blocks across one or more calendars (or attendee emails) in a window via the freeBusy API so you can compute the open gaps.

tools.name: google_calendar_create_event
tools.description: Create an event (timed or all-day) on a calendar. Mutating — confirm the details first.

tools.name: google_calendar_update_event
tools.description: Patch an existing event's fields — only the fields you pass change. Mutating — confirm the change first.

tools.name: google_calendar_delete_event
tools.description: Permanently delete an event. Destructive and irreversible — confirm the exact event (summary + start) first.
